headline: Trump pitches $5,000 checks, but only if GOP wins House and Senate
snapshot: President Trump vowed Wednesday to send a $5,000 "dividend" to every American citizen after the midterms, but only if Republicans hold onto control of Congress. He didn't offer details on how the payments would work. The key question is leverage: the next votes, negotiations and public pressure points will determine whether this becomes policy movement or political positioning.
